boards.title: Top 5 · Anytime touchdown
boards.basis: Opportunity touchdown model: cleared every bar on a blind test of 2014–2021 (35,128 player-games never used to build it). Probabilities condition on playing — a player who does not play settles void. Each week's forecast is frozen before the first kickoff and graded; its blind 2026 record is holding every bar (2405 graded player-games).

topBoards.ranking: Official player board only, ranked by the official median (yards, receptions) or the official probability (anytime touchdown); cleared players only; a maximum, never a quota. A family the board marks ESTIMATE ranks on the same median under the label "Estimate · … standard not yet met" and carries no price. Sportsbook prices, simulations and fallbacks never rank.
